application_credentials.description: Install the browser extension linked in the integration documentation before signing in. PostNL uses a registered public OAuth client; the Client ID and Client secret fields are not used by this integration.

pick_implementation.title: Connect PostNL
pick_implementation.description: Choose the PostNL credentials to use for sign-in.

data_description.implementation: The application credentials registered for PostNL.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect PostNL
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again using the same PostNL account. Your existing devices, entities, and dashboard configuration will be kept.

abort.missing_credentials: Add application credentials for PostNL before continuing.
abort.missing_configuration: No PostNL OAuth implementation is configured.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant needs a reachable callback URL. See {docs_url}.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out starting PostNL sign-in. Please try again.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out exchanging the authorization code. Please try again.
abort.oauth_failed: PostNL sign-in failed. Please try again.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: PostNL rejected the authorization code. Please sign in again.
abort.oauth_error: PostNL returned an invalid token response. Please try again.
abort.already_configured: This PostNL account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the PostNL account that was originally configured.
abort.account_identity_unknown: The original account could not be identified safely. Remove this integration entry and add the intended account again.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to PostNL. Please try again later.
abort.invalid_auth: PostNL rejected authentication. Please sign in again.
abort.invalid_response: PostNL did not return valid account information. Please try again later.

invalid_auth.message: PostNL authentication expired or was rejected. Sign in again.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to retrieve valid data from PostNL.

wrong_account.message: The credentials belong to a different PostNL account.

already_configured.message: This PostNL account is already configured.

data_description.delivered_retention_days: Show delivered parcels for this many days (0–3650). Set 0 to keep all parcels returned by PostNL. Parcels without a valid delivery timestamp remain visible.
